card.name: Capital D starting words in all-caps text
card.fires_on: A lone capital D (or hyphenated d) that begins a word split after a space or hyphen, mostly in all-caps warning text, such as DETERMINED, DUE, DURING, DEMENTIA, or well-documented.

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: A capital D starts a word like DETERMINED, DUE, DURING or DEMENTIA in capitalized label warnings.
modes.example: PATIENTS WITH NEPHROTOXICITY<< D>>UE TO POLYMYXIN B

modes.label: Hyphenated well-d words
modes.description: A d after a hyphen in compounds like well-documented or Well-Differentiated.
modes.example: His well<<-d>>ocumented hatred of the Kansas-Nebraska

card.writes: It lowers the odds of document-like completions (document, doc), which suggests the model is told the D is not starting that word.
card.plain: It fires on a capital D that begins a word in all-caps warnings or after a hyphen, as in well-documented.
